curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-beginner-plus-j: Plus Jakarta Sans draws every curve with one steady line and keeps its stroke ends well apart, which feels modern and exact. Plus Jakarta Sans pairs with the loose, handwritten Edu VIC WA NT Beginner, a friendlier fit for brief copy than for pages of it.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-gf-trispac: Edu VIC WA NT Hand writes small, loose letters under tall capitals, handy for custom embroidery patches. Trispace spreads its sans letters wide with curves that open outward, so it feels approachable, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Casual, crayon-rough and low-slung. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre has a faint thick-thin rhythm that earns its keep big and short, while Tsukimi Rounded brings soft round forms with parallel stroke edges.
curated-gf-elsie-gf-esteban: Esteban is a serif with fine crossbars and a wide-open e, refined and classic in the way it fills a line. Elsie is the loud one, fat stems with thread-thin hairlines made to be seen, while Esteban simply makes steady, quiet text.
curated-gf-elsie-instrument-sans: Fat ribbon stems, thread-thin hairlines. Elsie earns its keep big and short, and Instrument Sans stays out of its way with pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, handy on an about us team page.
curated-gf-elsie-swash-caps-gf-noto-sans: Stout stems crossed by delicate hairlines give Elsie Swash Caps a vivid tension, a bold start for personal trainer branding. And Noto Sans Mandaic follows with curvy, loose-feeling sans letters, which makes a handful of lines read smoothly.
curated-gf-elsie-swash-caps-gf-ovo: Ovo reads classic and spacious, with a tall middle band. Elsie Swash Caps brings brushy swells and thin crossbars, bold enough for roadmap slides, and Ovo's gentle thick-thin strokes steady the whole page beneath it.
curated-gf-engagement-sora: Loose, tightly packed handwriting. Sora comes in precise and geometric, with no swell at the curves and a c and s kept widely parted, while Engagement adds relaxed pen-and-paper charm, handy for a memoir notes page.
curated-gf-engagement-zilla-slab: Engagement writes in relaxed, nearly touching pen-and-paper letters with tiny gaps where curves should open up. Zilla Slab answers with broad, sturdy openings, so the two sit together comfortably.
